title: Veterans Pension Income Matches and Due-Process Notice
content:
# Income matches on a Veterans Pension award

When a Social Security or IRS data match shows income the Veterans Pension award does not reflect, VA sends a due-process notice proposing to adjust the rate from the date the matched income began.

**Response period (clause no longer in force).** The clause "The proposed adjustment from an income match is made only after 60 calendar days have passed since the date of the income-match notice" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for recording rate adjustments, and it is not applied as written. The 60-day response figure itself remains the product's figure.

**Counting the period.** Count calendar days starting the day after the notice date; the adjustment may be made on the day after the last day of the period. The day the notice is dated is not counted, and the last day of the period is not itself a day on which the adjustment may be made.

**Hearing.** A hearing requested within 30 days of the notice delays the adjustment until the hearing.

**Evidence.** Evidence that the matched income is wrong or was already reported is weighed before adjusting; a confirmed discrepancy is adjusted like a late-reported income increase and may create an overpayment.

## Counting illustrated (hypothetical notice date)

| Notice dated | Day 1 of the period | Last day (day 60) | First day the adjustment may be made |
|---|---|---|---|
| March 1, 2026 | March 2, 2026 | April 30, 2026 | May 1, 2026 |

A hearing request received ten days after a March 1, 2026 notice falls within the 30 days and delays the adjustment until the hearing; a request received forty-five days after it does not.

superseded_clauses: The proposed adjustment from an income match is made only after income_match_response_days calendar days have passed since the date of the income-match notice.
